title: Better Apart: When a Carve-Out Transforms Both Companies
observed_period: T+3 days through 24 months after carve-out, transaction sample timing unspecified
business_context: A carve-out should redesign both successor businesses, not merely complete separation
key_message: Full-potential carve-outs outperformed all carve-outs by 20.3 index points after 24 months; separation plus redesign may create additional value.

data_spec.grain: cohort × elapsed_period; initial T-3 days indexed baseline
data_spec.denominator: BCG benchmark series baseline=100; actual sample size undisclosed
data_spec.provenance: reported nine labeled post-event time points; derived initial index baseline 100 at T-3 days

data_recipe: Collect corporate event dates and classify cohorts
Index relative TSR series consistently to baseline 100
message_conditions: No assumption that co-occurrence proves causal effect
diff_notes: Original index baseline T-3 included as derived (100); source image values individually labeled for nine subsequent times. Typography and proprietary branding are not reproduced.

training_pair.instruction: Recreate BCG Exhibit 1 event-aligned two-series relative TSR index chart with visible numeric labels and a difference annotation, using reported index labels.
